chose: A WebView older than Chrome 111 (Vite's default target) gets a plain page instead of the app, through Capacitor's own check: android.minWebViewVersion 111 and server.errorPath webview-too-old.html, a page the phone build alone carries. It says "This phone needs a newer WebView", to update Android System WebView from the Play Store or, on Android 7 to 9 where Chrome is usually the WebView, Chrome, with a button to each one's Play page.
options: Capacitor's minWebViewVersion and errorPath, a static page
an inline script in index.html reading the user agent's Chrome version
gray: The owner approved the screen (#3117) but not its words, its link, or how an old WebView is recognised. Capacitor's check reads the installed WebView package, before the app loads; an inline script would read the user agent on every launch and push index.html's charset declaration later.
